subject: MSA + Order Form: temporary burst addendum & pricing alignment
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.r@meditech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Meditech Procurement <procurement@meditech.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@meditech.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary burst capacity & pricing cap request (Q4)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding so far. We have an urgent ask from our cloud ops & procurement teams: Meditech expects a 25-35% spike in inference traffic for a 6-week window starting 2026-11-01 (pilot + product demo series).

Can Redwood provide a temporary burst addendum to our Order Form to add the extra capacity and hold pricing at current committed rates for the duration? Procurement would prefer a short, signed addendum (no full MSA rewrite) plus a PO reference. Attached is the PO (Meditech_PO_478.pdf) and our proposed redline (meditech_msa_redline_v1.pdf) with callouts for an exhibit B addendum.

Key asks from Procurement:
- Add a temporary capacity exhibit (30% above committed throughput) from 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-15
- Explicit price cap during the window (no overage spikes beyond stated uplift)
- Minimal legal churn — prefer amendments to Order Form rather than MSA replacement

Can you confirm next steps and an internal owner for legal review & pricing impact? We need signoff by 2026-10-12 to align with internal purchase timelines.

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Head of Cloud Ops, Meditech
Elena.R@meditech.com

---

Attachment: meditech_msa_redline_v1.pdf (customer redline suggestions)

- We can do an addendum to the Order Form (Exhibit B-style temporary capacity) rather than a full MSA substitution.

- Marissa — please review the customer redline and advise required edits and risk flags.

Deliverables and target dates:
- Internal pricing note (Jordan) by 2026-10-07

- Draft addendum for customer review by 2026-10-09

Elena — if PO amount or billing instructions are different from the PO stub, please call out in a quick reply. We will try to keep the addendum focused on capacity and the price cap clause.

Thanks,

Subject: Pricing impact & billing flow for temporary burst (Meditech)

Kim / Irene — I reviewed the PO and ran a high-level pricing simulation. See attached kp_pricing_impact_sheet.xlsx for numbers. Short summary:
- 30% burst for 6 weeks increases expected monthly token consumption by ~28% (workloads are bursty but short-lived)
- If we keep current committed unit rates, the expected incremental revenue is within an acceptable threshold for a temporary addendum, provided we limit the window and require pre-payment or PO guarantee.

Recommended commercial structure:
1) Addendum that increases throughput by 30% for 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-15
2) Explicit price cap clause: any usage within the burst window billed at committed unit rates; overages beyond 30% subject to a negotiated on-call rate (suggest 1.25x committed unit price)
3) Require PO pre-payment or invoice upfront for the addendum period (Meditech prefers PO; confirm if AR can accept net-30 on PO)

I've attached a draft pricing note and a proposed exhibit skeleton. Legal (Marissa) — please advise if the price cap language below is acceptable or if you need alternate wording to preserve Sony-style indemnity carveouts.

Attachment: kp_pricing_impact_sheet.xlsx

-Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena.r@meditech.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Legal review: Meditech redline and proposed addendum

Team — I reviewed meditech_msa_redline_v1.pdf and attached a short comment set (legal_msa_comments_20261006.pdf). High-level guidance:

- Approach: we can accept an Order Form addendum limited to capacity and price-capping language. Avoid altering core MSA indemnities, data handling, or termination rights — Meditech's redline had a couple of risky edits there which we'd reject.

- Required edits we propose:
  * Exhibit B: add temporary capacity table and explicit start/end dates (2026-11-01 through 2026-12-15)
  * Price cap: "All usage attributable to the temporary capacity window shall be billed at Customer's committed unit rates, up to the defined burst uplift. Any usage beyond the uplift will be billed at 1.25x the committed unit price unless otherwise agreed in writing."
  * PO acceptance: require a signed addendum plus PO reference; do not accept unilateral PO changes to billing terms without a signed amendment.

- Risk flags from Meditech redline: attempted to change our data retention clause and broaden audit rights. Those will not pass. I marked those sections in the attached PDF.

Next steps:
1) Jordan — confirm whether Accounts Receivable can accept pre-invoice on PO numbers or we need pre-payment.
2) Kimberly — I will convert our comments into a one-page addendum draft for Meditech and include a short negotiation cover note. Expect that draft by 2026-10-08 morning.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: legal_msa_comments_20261006.pdf (legal comment set)
